description: Scaffold the Cargo binary crate with the LOCKED dependency stack, then implement and property-test the ENTIRE pure functional core: domain newtypes, ETrade endpoint constants, the full OAuth 1.0a signing pipeline (shared encoder, split_query/wire_query, the three-leg SigningInput domain, OauthParams, base string, HMAC-SHA1, authorization_header, sign_leg), the total admit() request-admission function + path mapping, the status typestate, config validation, authorize-URL builder, TLS fingerprint, relay-header whitelist, and the core thiserror error enums. The core tree must contain NO tokio/axum/reqwest/rustls/std::env/std::io references and must compile and test with no async runtime. This feature is the foundation; it must be complete and green before any shell code (FEAT-002). Independent of FEAT-002/003 only in that it has no dependencies; FEAT-002 depends on it.
steps: Create Cargo.toml (edition 2021, binary crate) pinning exact minor versions per the design's locked stack: tokio (features rt + macros for current_thread), axum, axum-server (feature tls-rustls), hyper, reqwest (default-features = false, features rustls-tls + json), rustls, rcgen = "0.14" (default features — the crypto feature is default in 0.14), hmac, sha1, base64 = "0.22", percent-encoding, url, secrecy = "0.10", rand, serde (derive), serde_json, thiserror, anyhow, clap (derive); dev-dependencies proptest, insta, wiremock, and tokio with test/macros features. Validate the pinned secrecy 0.10, rcgen 0.14, and base64 0.22 APIs compile as the design specifies.

Create .gitignore ignoring /target. Create src/main.rs (temporary `fn main() {}` for now — real wiring is FEAT-002), src/lib.rs declaring `pub mod core;` and `pub mod shell;` and re-exporting the core API for tests, and the full empty module tree so the crate compiles: src/core/{mod,newtypes,config,admission,relay,status,authorize_url,tls_fingerprint,error}.rs, src/core/oauth/{mod,endpoints,base_string,sign,params}.rs, src/shell/{mod,env,clock_nonce,tls,server,handlers,upstream,oauth_flow,prompt,state,error}.rs (shell files may be empty //! doc stubs this feature).

core/newtypes.rs: define ConsumerKey(String), ConsumerSecret(SecretString), RequestToken(String), TokenSecret(SecretString), AccessToken(String), Verifier(String), Nonce(String), Timestamp(u64), ListenPort(u16). Non-secret token types get a hand-written Debug that truncates/redacts; secret types rely on secrecy's redacting Debug, absent Display, and zeroize-on-drop (SecretString = SecretBox<str>; construct via SecretString::from(String); read via secrecy::ExposeSecret::expose_secret() -> &str).

core/oauth/endpoints.rs: define pub const UPSTREAM_HOST = "api.etrade.com", REQUEST_TOKEN_PATH = "/oauth/request_token", ACCESS_TOKEN_PATH = "/oauth/access_token", AUTHORIZE_URL_BASE = "https://us.etrade.com/e/t/etws/authorize", and pub fn oauth_endpoint_url(path: &str) -> String building format!("https://{UPSTREAM_HOST}{path}") so the host literal appears exactly once. Include the documented first-run-verification comment (leg paths + oauth_callback=oob are confirm-on-first-run assumptions).

core/oauth/mod.rs: define the shared RFC-3986 unreserved-only AsciiSet and pub fn oauth_encode(&str) -> String; pub fn split_query(path_and_query: &str) -> (String, Vec<(String,String)>) — total, percent-DECODE each name/value (on non-UTF-8 decode failure keep the raw substring verbatim), DROP params whose decoded name starts with oauth_, PRESERVE duplicates as an ordered Vec (no map, no de-dup); pub fn wire_query(pairs: &[(String,String)]) -> String re-serializing in client order with oauth_encode. Add the core enum HttpMethod (here or in core/admission.rs).

core/oauth/params.rs: define enum SigningInput<'a> { RequestToken{consumer_key, callback}, AccessToken{consumer_key, request_token, request_token_secret, verifier}, Resource{consumer_key, access_token, access_token_secret} }; struct OauthParams (fields: consumer_key, nonce, timestamp, signature_method="HMAC-SHA1", version="1.0", token: Option<String> (Some only for AccessToken=request token / Resource=access token), extra: Vec<(String,String)> for oauth_callback / oauth_verifier; NO oauth_signature field); pub fn oauth_params(&SigningInput, &Nonce, &Timestamp) -> OauthParams; impl OauthParams { pub fn as_pairs(&self) -> Vec<(String,String)> } emitting oauth_token only when present and every extra entry.

core/oauth/base_string.rs: pub fn upstream_base_url(path: &str) -> String => "https://" + endpoints::UPSTREAM_HOST + path (normalized: lowercase https, lowercase host, port 443 omitted, no query/fragment); pub fn signature_base_string(method: &HttpMethod, base_url: &str, base_params: &[(String,String)]) -> String => (1) oauth_encode each name+value, (2) stable-sort a COPY of the encoded pairs by encoded name then encoded value, (3) join name=value with &, (4) return METHOD + "&" + oauth_encode(base_url) + "&" + oauth_encode(joined). base_url is assumed already normalized (built only via upstream_base_url).

core/oauth/sign.rs: pub fn signing_key(&ConsumerSecret, Option<&TokenSecret>) -> String => oauth_encode(consumer_secret) + "&" + oauth_encode(token_secret_or_empty) — the ONE source-level expose_secret() site, exposed &str never escapes; pub fn sign_hmac_sha1(base_string, signing_key) -> String using hmac+sha1 then base64 0.22 Engine base64::engine::general_purpose::STANDARD.encode(mac_bytes); pub fn authorization_header(&OauthParams, &signature) -> String rendering EXACTLY as_pairs() + the inserted oauth_signature, each value oauth_encode'd and double-quoted, pairs name-sorted and comma-space separated, scheme literal "OAuth ", NO realm; pub fn sign_leg(&SigningInput, &ConsumerSecret, query_params: &[(String,String)], &Nonce, &Timestamp) -> SignedLeg (the single enforcing call site: derives OauthParams via oauth_params, picks the leg's token secret via signing_key, builds base_params = as_pairs() ++ query_params, signs, renders header). struct SignedLeg { authorization_header: String, oauth_params: OauthParams }.

core/admission.rs: define Admission { Forward(UpstreamPath), Status, Reject(RejectReason) }, #[non_exhaustive] RejectReason { MethodNotGet, OutOfPrefix }, UpstreamPath(String), and the TOTAL pub fn admit(method: &HttpMethod, path_and_query: &str) -> Admission — verb-first (non-GET => Reject(MethodNotGet) regardless of path), then GET /internal/status => Status, GET whose path (before '?') starts with /etrade-api/v1/accounts AND the next char is '/', '?', or end => Forward mapping /etrade-api -> /v1/accounts and preserving the query verbatim, else Reject(OutOfPrefix). Use only total string ops (strip_prefix, split on '?'); never index or panic.

core/status.rs: struct Unauthorized; struct Authorized { access_token: AccessToken, token_secret: TokenSecret }; impl Unauthorized { pub fn authorize(self, AccessToken, TokenSecret) -> Authorized } (consuming); #[derive(serde::Serialize)] struct StatusBody { authorized: bool }; pub fn status_body_unauthorized() -> StatusBody; pub fn status_body_authorized(&Authorized) -> StatusBody (never reads the token bytes).

core/config.rs: struct EnvSnapshot { consumer_key: Option<String>, consumer_secret: Option<String> }; struct Config { consumer_key: ConsumerKey, consumer_secret: ConsumerSecret, port: ListenPort }; pub fn build_config(&EnvSnapshot, ListenPort) -> Result<Config, ConfigError> treating empty strings as missing.

core/authorize_url.rs: pub fn authorize_url(&ConsumerKey, &RequestToken) -> String => AUTHORIZE_URL_BASE + "?key={key}&token={token}" with key/token encoded using ordinary application/x-www-form-urlencoded query encoding, NOT oauth_encode.
core/tls_fingerprint.rs: pub fn fingerprint(der: &[u8]) -> String computing SHA-256 over the DER bytes rendered as lowercase hex with colon separators (32 colon-separated octets).

core/relay.rs: pub fn relay_header_allowed(name: &str) -> bool — whitelist Content-Type, Date, ETag, and caching headers; reject Content-Length and all hop-by-hop headers (Connection, Transfer-Encoding, Keep-Alive, Upgrade, ...).

core/error.rs: #[non_exhaustive] ConfigError { MissingConsumerKey, MissingConsumerSecret, EmptyConsumerKey, EmptyConsumerSecret } (messages name the variable, never the value); #[non_exhaustive] OauthParseError { MissingField{field}, MalformedForm } with #[from] where useful; plus the pure form-body parser (parses application/x-www-form-urlencoded OAuth responses: oauth_token, oauth_token_secret, oauth_callback_confirmed) returning Result<_, OauthParseError>.
Write unit + proptest tests for every pure module (co-located #[cfg(test)] modules and/or src tests). Commit the proptest-regressions/ seeds and insta .snap files that the tests produce.
acceptance_criteria: `cargo build` completes with no errors on the scaffolded crate (AC-1).
`cargo test` passes all core unit and proptest tests (AC-3 for the core).

OAuth determinism (proptest, AC-4): fixed injected nonce/timestamp yields an identical base string and HMAC-SHA1 signature across repeated calls; varying nonce/timestamp changes the output; base-string construction is correct over arbitrary parameter sets (percent-encoding + sort).

Base-string/header agreement across all three legs (proptest): the (name,value) multiset parsed back out of authorization_header (excluding oauth_signature) equals OauthParams.as_pairs(); the RequestToken leg emits NO oauth_token; AccessToken and Resource legs emit exactly one; driven through sign_leg so the token/secret pairing is exercised.
split_query is total over arbitrary strings (never panics), drops oauth_* names, preserves duplicates as a multiset, and non-UTF-8 escapes keep signed-set == wire-set (proptest).
signed-pair multiset == wire_query pair multiset including a dedicated duplicate-key case (e.g. ?symbol=A&symbol=B&symbol=A) (proptest).

admit is total (AC-8); non-GET never Forward (AC-5); out-of-prefix GET never Forward with /internal/status excluded from that arm (AC-6) plus a dedicated GET /internal/status == Status example; in-prefix GET admitted and mapped to /v1/accounts/... with query preserved (AC-7).
status serialization snapshots to {"authorized":false} and {"authorized":true} (insta, AC-10).
build_config rejects missing/empty each credential var with a typed error naming the variable (AC-11).

authorize_url matches the encode-neutral literal https://us.etrade.com/e/t/etws/authorize?key={key}&token={token} (AC-12), plus a separate test proving +,/,= encode to %2B/%2F/%3D (form-urlencoding, not oauth_encode).
tls_fingerprint matches a precomputed SHA-256 lowercase colon-hex vector; relay_header_allowed table test passes.
findings:
COMPLETE and green. cargo build + `cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings` (zero warnings) + cargo test (79 tests: unit + proptest + insta) all pass. No live ETrade calls.

Crate: name `etrade-local-proxy`, Rust 2021, single binary crate (src/main.rs is temporary `fn main() {}`; src/lib.rs declares `pub mod core; pub mod shell;`). Module paths: core::{newtypes, config, admission, relay, status, authorize_url, tls_fingerprint, error}, core::oauth::{mod, endpoints, base_string, sign, params}; shell::{env, clock_nonce, tls, server, handlers, upstream, oauth_flow, prompt, state, error} are //! doc stubs for FEAT-002 to implement. core/ tree references no tokio/axum/reqwest/rustls/std::env/std::io (grep-verified; only doc-comment mentions).

Exact pinned versions (Cargo.toml caret pins; resolved lockfile versions in parens): tokio 1.48 (features rt,macros,io-std,io-util; resolved 1.53.1), axum 0.8 (0.8.9), axum-server 0.7 (tls-rustls; 0.7.3) [NOTE: design text said axum-server 0.8 but 0.8 does not exist on crates.io — latest is 0.7.x; used 0.7], hyper 1.7 (1.11.1), reqwest 0.12 (default-features=false, rustls-tls+json; 0.12.28), rustls 0.23 (0.23.45), rcgen 0.14 (0.14.10, default features incl. crypto), hmac 0.12, sha1 0.10, sha2 0.10 [ADDED to stack: design specifies SHA-256 for the TLS fingerprint but did not list a SHA-256 crate; sha2 0.10 is the RustCrypto sibling of sha1], base64 0.22, percent-encoding 2.3, url 2.5, secrecy 0.10, rand 0.8, serde 1.0 (derive), serde_json 1.0, thiserror 2.0, anyhow 1.0, clap 4.5 (derive). dev-deps: proptest 1.8 (1.11.0), insta 1.44 (1.48.0, json feature), wiremock 0.6, tokio (test-util). base64 0.22 Engine API (general_purpose::STANDARD.encode), secrecy 0.10 (SecretString=SecretBox<str>, SecretString::from(String), ExposeSecret::expose_secret()->&str), and rcgen 0.14 all compile as the design specifies — validated at build time.

API SURPRISES / DECISIONS for FEAT-002:
1. axum-server latest is 0.7.x, NOT 0.8 — Cargo.toml pins 0.7 with tls-rustls. 2. Added sha2 0.10 for the fingerprint SHA-256 (design omitted it). 3. rustls 0.23 pulls aws-lc-rs by default; FEAT-002's shell::tls must choose/instantiate a rustls CryptoProvider (aws-lc-rs is the default and compiled fine, or switch rustls to the `ring` feature) — not exercised yet since shell is stubbed.
4. OPTION B APPLIED (per parent decision) to resolve the sign_leg/resource-path tension: added `core::newtypes::ResourcePath(String)` (the mapped upstream path, query already split off) and a `path: &'a ResourcePath` field to `SigningInput::Resource`. `sign_leg` now builds every leg's base URL from the single SigningInput value (token legs from endpoint constants, resource leg via `upstream_base_url(path.as_str())`), so sign_leg is total over all three legs and is the single enforcing production call site. Lower-level pipeline fns (oauth_params, signature_base_string, sign_hmac_sha1, authorization_header, signing_key, upstream_base_url, split_query, wire_query) remain public for property tests. Tests `resource_leg_base_string_reflects_mapped_path` and proptest `resource_base_url_tracks_path` cover that the resource base string reflects the actual mapped path.
   => FEAT-002 ACTION: in the proxy handler, after `split_query(upstream_path)` -> (path, query_params), construct `ResourcePath::new(path)` and pass it as `SigningInput::Resource { ..., path: &resource_path }` to sign_leg (NOT the old /v1/accounts placeholder, which no longer exists). Pass the split query_params as sign_leg's query_params arg; wire the outbound URL via `wire_query(&query_params)`.
5. Secret access: the ONE source-level expose_secret() site is `core::oauth::sign::signing_key`. ConsumerSecret/TokenSecret expose `.secret() -> &SecretString`.
6. insta snapshots committed under src/core/snapshots/ (status_authorized, status_unauthorized). No proptest-regressions/ dir exists yet (no property failed); it will appear if a future property fails and should then be committed.
7. HttpMethod core enum lives in core::oauth (mod.rs). admit() lives in core::admission and maps RejectReason::MethodNotGet->405, OutOfPrefix->404 (shell wires those codes).
